newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Stunted Australia bonds left behind the bloc.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Stunted Australia bonds left behind the bloc.

text.p: Australian bonds showed a mild underperformance against other dollar bloc bonds following the Christmas festivities in thin trade.

A lack of definite direction from the U.S. either side of the holiday left the local market with few incentives to trade, compounded by the fact that it has to wait well into the new year before its own data flow resumes.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year spread again finds itself testing resistance at 110 basis points, which could put further downward pressure on the local market if there is a clear break.
The most notable move was against the short end of the Canadian curve, although this market has not traded since Tuesday due to the holiday season.
The New Zealand market also lacked an immediate clear focus.
